description: Ministry of Higher Education - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 1448/27 entering "18, Department  of Family Medicine " to the University of Colombo
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an official order issued under statutory authority (Section 27(1) of the Act) to modify the schedule of faculties and departments at the University of Colombo. While it mentions a minister's name and title, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing a legal instrument that amends existing regulations governing university structure. The content focuses on regulatory framework modification rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
